row.name: HCI Group Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=26 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.38 tightness=0.73 base_volume_vs_leg=0.82 base_volume_vs_avg=0.95
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 26 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.38 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 1.0% vs its 20-SMA, 1.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base spans 26 sessions — well outside the 3–20 session window — and the chart confirms it: the shaded box shows a wide, choppy consolidation from early August through mid-September with multiple overlapping bars and no tightening. On top of that, the burst bar's volume is only 59% of the prior session and fails the extended-base catalyst-volume requirement (needs 1.5× the 50-session average), and RE is 0.69 — the bar is not even the widest of the last five. Three independent failures (C, VOL, RE) converge on the same conclusion: this is a tired, loose base with a weak breakout bar.
claude.key_risk: Prior breakouts from this move worked 0 of 2, and the base's 26-session length with 0.38 giveback means the consolidation has already absorbed most of the leg's energy.
claude.entry_note: Skip regardless of open — the setup fails on base length, volume, and range expansion simultaneously, and no gap or strong open can repair those structural defects.

row.summary: HCI: +1.0% on 0.6× volume out of a base 9.8% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
